diode_placement_policy.purpose: hand-solder approach opposite the bottom-side Choc socket body while preserving the lower-housing perimeter land

battery_lead_pass_through_slot.layers: mask-only NPTH, no carrier power copper
battery_lead_pass_through_slot.purpose: USB-end lead exit below the nice!nano battery-pad end; route insulated B+ and GND/B- leads between the socket rows and provide strain relief

housing_assumption: FDM PLA+ lower tray with external perimeter capture and independent underside supports
notes: SOD-123 1N4148W fallback is used because DO-35 conflicts with the compact hybrid switch footprint at 19.05 mm pitch.
Antenna keepout rule areas are generated directly in the board files.
Switch footprint values are sanitized as KEY_XX so Specctra DSN export does not expose legend characters such as backslash to Freerouting.
Right-half R_COL7 uses D21 and R_COL8 uses D20 to keep the longer outer column on the easier controller fanout pin.
Controller protrusion tabs are aligned toward the inner joining edge: left recessed 12 mm, right recessed 17 mm.
Programming tact switch uses the smaller DeviceMart 1322056 NW3-A06-B3 SMD footprint.
X3 V2 uses the KC2-owned Choc V2/PG1353 bottom-side hot-swap socket plus Cherry MX 5-pin direct-solder geometry.
Choc V1 switch geometry, Choc V2 direct-solder pads, and MX hot-swap socket pads are intentionally excluded.
The Choc socket and MX switch are mutually exclusive assembly options at every key position.
X3 V2 uses the fixed 71-key v4 no-stabilizer layout: 32 left keys and 39 right keys, with no key wider than 1.75U.

X3 V2 insets every non-controller key-field edge 1.5 mm from the nominal switch-cell perimeter. Rows 0-3 use 8.025 mm center-to-edge offsets on both sides; bottom Space-B uses 10.40625 mm left / 8.025 mm right.
X3 V2 contains no legacy H1-H9 or REG1-REG9 key-field through-holes.
The netless battery-lead slot is at the nice!nano USB/B+ end; insulated B+ and GND/B- leads must use strain relief and remain outside the antenna keepout.
X3 V2 uses verified edge-safe SOD-123 offsets at perimeter keys; the limiting D2 envelope is nominally 1.35 mm inside Edge.Cuts while retaining hybrid-switch assembly and hand-solder clearance.
